notes.title: Mind Garden is looking like a Fall 2025 Release!!
notes.notes: [p]Hey, long time no chat! It's almost been a year since the last community post. In that time I've finished writing the story, designing the quests, completed all features, and even been working with a composer! [/p][p]You may have forgotten about the game. If thats the case, no worries! The game looks and feels quite different than the demo you played in October. Check the updated Steam page to see how it looks! I also created a video to show how the day [url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/PZEDgHktyYU"]progresses in the garden.[/url][/p][p]Additionally, I've decided to price the game; $5.99 USD will be the base price for Mind Garden. I like to think of it as you buying a short game to play over a weekend. If that seems too much - again, no worries! Expect to have multiple HEAVY sales. Further, I plan to discount the game to [b]free[/b] later on! This is how I plan to have many people play the game and support my future projects. And finally - I'm excited to announce- Mind Garden was approved for the Humble Storefront! The page will be up close to release. [/p][p]For more updates, stay tuned here on the community page. However, if you'd like more frequent updates and even 1:1 chats with me, join my discord![/p][p]Find the link to all my socials [url="https://josephsmithberger.com"]through my new portfolio page![/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/sbS4P2e8a3" style="button"]Click here for my Discord Server[/url][/p][p]Thanks for reading, see you soon![/p][p]PS: new trailer with original music is in the worksːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p]
